title: Fix `iread_xyz` to avoid `RuntimeError: generator raised StopIteration`
body:
# Summary

This MR fixes `RuntimeError: generator raised StopIteration` in `iread_xyz` when called in a for loop.

# Details

`iread_xyz` has been implemented in https://gitlab.com/ase/ase/-/merge_requests/341 to read the extended-XYZ file as an iterator.
[This has however not been tested](https://ase.gitlab.io/ase/coverage-html/z_fc41ef7ac65888e5_extxyz_py.html#t550).

For the following `test.xyz`
```
1
Properties=species:S:1:pos:R:3 pbc="F F F"
H        0.00000000       0.00000000       0.00000000
```
the following `test.py` shows `RuntimeError: generator raised StopIteration`.
```python
from ase.io.extxyz import iread_xyz

with open("test.xyz") as fd:
    for atoms in iread_xyz(fd):
        print(atoms)
```
while if correct it should leave the for loop after reading the last frame.
This error is due to the `while True` loop and the following `next(fd)` line in `ixyzchunks`.

The present MR fixes the issue with replaceing `while True` with `for line in fd` so that it can go out the loop after reading the file till the end.

@askhl Could you have a review on it, as it is related to your `ImageIterator`?

# Notes

As far as I understand !341, `read_xyz` was planed to re-implement with `iread_xyz`, but it has not been done yet. We therefore need to test `iread_xyz` separately, but once `read_xyz` starts relying on `iread_xyz`, the separate test would not be necessary.

I switch `next(fd)` to `fd.readline()` in order to avoid `OSError: telling position disabled by next() call` (see https://stackoverflow.com/q/29618936). To make it complete, we also need to revise `_read_xyz_frame`, but I would so far leave it for future revision.

Several annotations are also done for preparation of follow-up MRs I plan (e.g. for #1853).
